title: LEVEL8 Hard-Shell Trolley 36 L — with TSA Lock and Laptop Compartment

long_description: The LEVEL8 hard-shell trolley offers 36 litres of space and measures approx. 37 x 25 x 55.5 cm. The hard shell is made of ABS and the weight is 4.08 kg. The case is expandable. Colour: grey. Please compare the dimensions with your airline's rules before flying.
